name: Historical Calendar for Progressive Career
author: Dejw
description: Season calendars for Swofty Progressive Career, from 2015 to 2026. Steam only. EA app is unsupported in this release. Grand Prix settings let you choose optional historical circuits.

options.label: Disable sprints (2015–2020)
options.description: Use standard weekends in Progressive Career seasons before 2021. Choose this before generating a season or starting a new weekend.

options.label: Historical sprint weekends (2021–2026)
options.description: Use each season's historical sprint venues in Progressive Career. Turn off to use the sprint venues programmed in the game. Choose this before generating a season or starting a new weekend.
